signal.expiry: nearest mapped lifecycle-valid future-option expiry strictly after decision, at most7calendar days; if fill reaches it, flat without substituting a later expiry
signal.pool: one compatible series/unit/lot/exercise-style for exact underlying; reported finite nonnegative OI only, no missing-to-zero replacement
signal.primary: direction toward the greater reported call+put OI among the two immediately bracketing reported strikes
signal.control: direction toward the nearest of those same two strikes, without OI magnitude comparison
signal.tie_policy: equal OI or equal strike distance means flat for that arm; exact observed strike means both flat
signal.unknown_reported_mapping: any usable reported OI with unresolved metadata for that asset release masks the release; explicitly non-future option classes are excluded and counted
signal.invalid_oi: mask nonfinite/negative OI as unavailable, retain counts; a strike with no usable OI is not zero
signal.missing_new_release: latest actually available asset release supersedes old, even if unusable; never fall back to older good data
signal.eligibility: strict-prior source date and availability; completed exact same-contract decision close only; no future prices or label validity

execution.ledger: existing daily integer-contract portfolio ledger, no new engine
execution.terminal: flat on each asset's final declared effective date

pending_before_any_real_numeric_run: V89 terminal source manifest and source metadata mapping/coverage
exact raw-description to dated underlying/quote-unit binding; SI ambiguity must not be guessed
full economic config/code/input hashes and fixed assessment gates
server verification before a single2arms-by2costs run
limitations: Synthetic adapter is not historical evidence, a complete backtest, or Stage2 admission.
Pre-expiry daily convergence is not last-minute expiry pinning. Failure of this rule does not test every intraday version.
Reported subset is not full-market OI or dealer gamma. All-NULL contracts remain in source coverage; complete expiry-specific denominator is unknown.
Historical static metadata and next-day publication proxy are not original-PIT proof. Protected2026 outcomes remain unread.
